        Month close

        Admin only. After the bills of a month are submitted, close the month: no diesel, Log Book, tank-check or breakdown entry dated on or before the date can then be added, changed or deleted – by anyone. Bills, debit notes and payments are not closed.

        Machinery Billing

        Pick the period and the vendors – one bill (one page) per vendor, all its machinery in it. Preview to check; Verify & Submit – the system checks each bill against the Log Book, diesel and BOQ, then submits and opens it to print.

        Company & site

        This copy of Fleet ERP (One Click Solution) is for one company and one site. Every user below belongs to this site; another site has its own link, its own users and its own data – a user of this site cannot open it.

        Users & Access

        Who can open each page: Edit (add / change / delete), View (see and print) or No access (page hidden). Same list as the Users tab – a change works at once for that user.
        EditViewNo access

        A new user, or a password reset, gets a one-time password that works once – at that sign-in the user must set his own. Admin users have Edit on every page.

        My profile

        Your own settings – they belong to your sign-in and are the same on every computer. Nobody else's app changes. Every change is saved by itself.Saved ✔
